A general- ised pruritic macular rash was reported in a patient given foscar- net, which subsided after the drug was withdrawn.1 There have been several reports of genital ulceration,2-7 possibly related to local toxicity arising from high concentrations of fo- scarnet in the urine. Oral ulceration, usually with genital ulcera- tion, has occurred during foscarnet treatment.3-5 Uvular and oesophageal ulcerations have also been reported.4,8 1. Green ST, et al.
